data_quality_notes: Direct VIIRS Nighttime Lights in Protected Areas data were not available through any public tabular API. The Earth Observation Group (EOG) publishes annual VIIRS composites (VNL V2), but no pre-computed country-level protected-area summary table is publicly available without custom GIS processing. Substituted World Bank indicator 'Access to electricity (%)' (EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS) as the closest available tabular proxy for human infrastructure / settlement. Note that electricity access is only loosely correlated with NTL radiance inside protected areas and does not capture the within-PA signal the hypothesis targets. Results should be interpreted with caution.
summary: Tested whether 174 country-level observations show a negative relationship between access-to-electricity (EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS, used as substitute for VIIRS Nighttime Lights in Protected Areas) and the proportion of protected areas free from cropland/buildings (PHL). Pearson r = -0.149 (p = 0.050), Spearman rho = -0.127 (p = 0.096). Best functional form: linear. True VIIRS Nighttime Lights in Protected Areas data were unavailable; the substitute indicator is a weak proxy that operates at the national rather than within-protected-area level.
